paid_plans: Hosted: Free, Pro ($100/month), Business ($500/month), Enterprise (custom); pricing at discourse.org/pricing. Self-hosted is free open-source software. API/webhook access is included on Pro+ (and Free has limits per the plan grid).
resolution_notes: pricing.paid_plans: Auditor correct. Official pricing page lists Free, Pro ($100/mo), Business ($500/mo), Enterprise (custom)—not Standard/Business/Enterprise.
